_meta.indication: ZYNLONTA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma after two or more lines of systemic therapy, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified, DLBCL arising from low grade lymphoma, and high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

pivotal_trials.population: 145 adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma after at least 2 prior systemic regimens; median age 66 years (range 23 to 94), 59% male, median 3 prior therapies
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate (ORR) as assessed by an Independent Review Committee (IRC) using Lugano 2014 criteria
pivotal_trials.result: ORR per IRC 48.3% (95% CI 39.9, 56.7), with 24.1% achieving a complete response; median duration of response 10.3 months (95% CI 6.9, not evaluable)

key_safety: Most common (≥20%) adverse reactions including lab abnormalities: thrombocytopenia, increased gamma-glutamyltransferase, neutropenia, anemia, hyperglycemia, transaminase elevation, fatigue, hypoalbuminemia, rash, edema, nausea, and musculoskeletal pain. Grade 3 or 4 neutropenia in 32%, thrombocytopenia in 20%, anemia in 12%. Serious adverse reactions in 28%; fatal adverse reactions in 1% due to infection.
target_moa: CD19-directed antibody-drug conjugate; the monoclonal antibody binds human CD19, is internalized, and releases the pyrrolobenzodiazepine (PBD) dimer SG3199, a DNA crosslinking agent that forms cytotoxic DNA interstrand crosslinks inducing cell cycle arrest and cell death.
modality: ADC (antibody-drug conjugate): CD19-directed monoclonal antibody conjugated to the PBD dimer SG3199
companion_dx_detail: Devices and Companion Diagnostic Issues: Not applicable

advisory_committee.vote: This application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee or other external consultants because the application did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues for the recommended indication.

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate [see *Clinical Studies (14.1)*]. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s).

confirmatory_requirement.text: Conduct a randomized, phase 3 clinical trial (PMR 4029-1) to verify and describe the clinical benefit of loncastuximab tesirine-lpyl in patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma; primary endpoint progression-free survival.

citations.quote: 4029-1 Conduct a randomized, phase 3 clinical trial to verify and describe the clinical benefit of loncastuximab tesirine-lpyl in patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma.
The primary endpoint should be progression-free survival, with secondary endpoints that include overall survival and objective response rate.

summary.text: ZYNLONTA received accelerated approval under 21 CFR 601.41 based on overall response rate, with a required confirmatory randomized phase 3 trial. The application was granted Priority Review and had Orphan Drug designation for DLBCL; it was approved first cycle and was not taken to an advisory committee.
